data.summary: Dispatch 4 specialists on different genes of 3 loci: locus_variant (6 genes), qtl_gwas (8 genes), function_orthology (9 genes), literature (4 genes).
steps: Locus and variant specialist: Validate each locus window and state the positional relation of the genes nearest each lead SNP; flag duplicated genes in the window.
QTL and GWAS specialist: Check QTLs, catalog GWAS hits and curated genes for plant height over each locus and these genes; note competing curated genes.
Function and orthology specialist: Assess domains, GO and Arabidopsis ortholog phenotypes of these genes against the plant height profile; separate own from transferred evidence.
Literature specialist: Search the literature for these genes with plant height terms and quote passages; classify each relation.
